Fragrance brand · anonymous · Managed through March 2026

Giving a new fragrance account a start on TikTok

I set up the TikTok account and followed a regular posting routine. About 94% of recorded traffic came from the For You feed during the selected reporting period.

My role

I set up the account, researched what worked on TikTok, planned a daily posting routine and reviewed the results.

Sector

Social platforms · TikTok organic

Status

Case study / supplied platform screenshot

Topics

TikTok · Organic discovery · Account setup

01 / Starting point

The challenge

The fragrance brand had no TikTok account and wanted its videos to be discovered without paid promotion.

The insight

Posting regularly helps, but the content also needs to fit what people are already watching and searching for on TikTok.

02 / The approach

The plan

  • Create and secure the account before posting.
  • Post regularly with captions and video formats suited to TikTok.
  • Check TikTok traffic sources to see whether new people are finding the videos.
03 / Execution

Make the rhythm visible.

Getting started

I created the TikTok account and completed the setup.

Posting

I planned daily posts, worked on captions and used relevant keywords and hashtags.

Reviewing the numbers

I checked which traffic sources brought viewers to the account and how people interacted with posts.

06 / Selected proof

A closer look at the work.

These examples include dates and sources so you can see what they show and what they do not.

04 / Results

Evidence with the label still attached.

The supplied TikTok analytics show 10.3K views, 690 likes, 25 shares and 88 profile views in the selected reporting period. Around 94% of views came from the For You feed. That measures discovery, not sales.

05 / Reflection

What stays after the campaign?

The account reached people beyond its followers, but views alone cannot tell us whether those people became customers.
